title: Bruce Hauman - Developing ClojureScript With Figwheel
summary: Bruce Hauman presents Figwheel, a ClojureScript tool for live, interactive development with hot code reloading. He explains the main ideas, demonstrates how it works, and shares tricks for getting the most out of it.
why: HN people point to it as a very visual demonstration of what hot-reloading and interactive development can offer, and as an example of a great dev tool pitch.

quote.text: it's a very visual demonstration of what hot-reloading code and interactive development can bring
